questions.stem: Which of the following best defines a citizen?

options.text: A person who is legally recognized as a member of a state.
A person who lives in a country without legal status.
A foreigner residing temporarily in a country.
A person who has renounced their citizenship.

questions.explanation: A citizen is someone who has legal recognition as a member of a state, which includes rights and duties. Options b, c, and d describe non-citizens or those who have lost their citizenship status.

questions.stem: How can a person acquire Nigerian citizenship by registration?

By residing in Nigeria and fulfilling legal requirements.
By serving in the Nigerian military.

questions.explanation: Citizenship by registration requires an individual to reside in Nigeria and meet specific legal criteria. Options a, c, and d do not accurately describe the process of registration.
